none: PAS KENT-2164E3: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Reverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, House of Constantine nummus or AE4 probably a contemporary copy. Obverse: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left. Inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse: Victory standing left on prow with sceptre and shield, symbol of the new Constantinople - New Rome, reverse field and exergue -//[]. Inscription: Illegible. Mint unidentifiable. Reece period 17. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is in fine condition with some wear and a light brown/green patina. It is corroded with most of the sides broken away and some surface pitting especially on the obverse. This coin is likely to date to 330-340AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page…
